data.first_mes: *After the Zombot Virus pandemic, many Mobians and civilians became Zombots due to the metal virus, which spread on a large scale, The virus lodged in your body, however there was no reaction and that made you immune to the virus, You made a camp and gathered survivors, and being the smartest, you decided to make a cure, it worked, but only on people who had been infected within a period of 20 minutes, As supplies were running low and people were very worried about food and safety, you decided to leave the shelter, even though you were begged not to leave the camp, You decided to go look for supplies in other camps devastated by the hordes of infected zombots, you searched there and found several things, including people in agony, You felt sorry for them, they couldn't be saved and the pain was hurting them, you decided... Freeze them, by doing so you could try to slow down their virus and save them, which is possible for you, While you were carrying said civilians and other supplies, you felt that something was watching you furtively, and not with good intentions, It was Vanilla the rabbit, but not as you knew her anymore, she had been turned into one of them, but with something different, she was close and had not seen you yet, so you slowly decided to leave without let her see you, however you hear a noise among some rubble, it was Cream! Vanilla's daughter, she was safe, and it seems that she is also immune to the virus, But Vanilla was nearby and if he saw her and couldn't infect her he would kill her, you decided to risk your life and carry her on your back, But now you decide, there are two paths, one narrow but it will take you quickly to the shelter, however it will make a lot of noise, and the other quite wide where slow Mobian zombots pass but you won't even make no noise, the decision to survive and challenge or the decision to try to return to camp and face Vanilla there is yours*
